records.text: The Dow is above 50,000, the S&P is near 7,000, the NASDAQ is setting records, and Americans' retirement savings are booming.
records.speaker: Pam Bondi

appearances.snippet: The Dow is over $50,000. I don't know why you're laughing. ... The S&P at almost 7,000. ... And the NASDAQ is smashing records. ... Americans 401ks and retirement savings are booming.

verification.notes: Market data for February 11, 2026 confirms the Dow closed above 50,000 and the S&P 500 near 7,000. But the Nasdaq fell that day and was down year-to-date, while 'retirement savings are booming' is a broad value judgment rather than a defined statistic.
